brief.zh: 已知「下雨 ∧ 刮风」和「下雨 → 地湿」，证出「地湿 ∧ 刮风」。
brief.en: Given “it rains ∧ it is windy” and “it rains → the ground is wet”, prove “the ground is wet ∧ it is windy”.

hint.zh: 先拆开 ∧，拿到「下雨」去套用；再把「地湿」和「刮风」拼起来。
hint.en: Split the ∧ first and apply the given to “it rains”; then join “the ground is wet” with “it is windy”.

t.zh: 真值电路里的「与」门：两边都真，才输出真。证明器里，「…与…」写成 ∧，照着这张表有两块元件。
t.en: The “and” gate of the truth circuits: true only when both sides are true. In the prover “… and …” is written ∧, and that table gives it two parts.

t.zh: 拼成 ∧：两边都证出来了，就有「左边 ∧ 右边」，正是表里唯一为真的那一行。拆开 ∧：有了「左边 ∧ 右边」，两边就都是真的，它有两个输出口。
t.en: Join ∧: with both sides proved, “left ∧ right”, just the one row of the table where it is true. Split ∧: from “left ∧ right” both sides are true; it has two outputs.

after.zh: 拆开、套用、拼成。两块元件都不用开框：它们只是把「与」门的真值表变成了规则。
after.en: Split, apply, join. Neither part opens a box: they are the “and” gate’s truth table turned into rules.
